title: Ben and the Very Small Welcome Committee
synopsis: Ben tries to replace the missing squeak with a committee made of a pebble and a leaf; a wiggly wave works better, and the committee retires.
continuity_state: Before: The Story House hinge has been repaired and its door no longer squeaks. Ben knows this, Amy kept the original squeak curl on her map, and Sue and Grandpa Ed live on the orchard path. After: Ben invents a pretend welcome committee of a found pebble and leaf, then returns them to the path/tree after the afternoon. Ben coins the wibble-wave, which Sue, Amy and Grandpa Ed have seen. No sign, bench prop or new shelf item remains. Story House door still opens quietly.
